metadata.methods_description: Participants sat 110 cm from a screen and viewed 20 ms flashes of vertical color photographs (about 4.5 x 6.5 degrees of visual angle) presented with a 2000 ms SOA (±200 ms jitter). They lifted a finger from a touch-sensitive button for targets (go) within 1000 ms and kept pressing for distractors (nogo). Two alternating tasks were used, animal categorization and recognition of a probe image learned in a preceding learning phase. Day 1 had 13 series and day 2 had 12 series, each with 100 images (50 targets, 50 non-targets).
